I use absolutely none of these because I don't like the systems format. comments.text:
I will forever stand by this opinion (rant):
You should be able to deconstruct and reconstruct it any way you want. Modular doesn't mean modular in this case, and they should be. Modular heavily implies that you easily take it apart and swap out the needed piece. What if I don't like my amp because it doesn't suit my play style? Let me swap around my parts. Don't force me to re-grind the damn thing and force me to make an entire new one. Just let me switch it around! Moas, kitguns, and zaws. I use absolutely none of these because I don't like the systems format. I got my first zaw, built it, reached lv 30, went "ok, let's see what other configuration I can do" and then realized I would need to grind the whole thing out again because you can't disassemble it. Iirc, DE themselves have said that the system is outdated. This can help fix that!
